newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 7.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - May 7.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Wednesday:

* On Tuesday, the Dow rose 10.83 points to 7,225.32, surpassing the previous day's record of 7,214.49, and setting its 17th high for the year, as investors withdrew funds from the bond market to join the stock rally.
* Indonesia's consumer price index for April was likely to show a month-on-month rise of 0.55-0.57 percent, compared with a decline of 0.12 percent in March, banking sources said on Tuesday.
The government is expected to announce the official figure later on Wednesday.
* On Tuesday, the Jakarta composite index rose 6.82 points to close at 659.60 points.
* On Wednesday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,427.50/28.00 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,425.50/26.50.
* Conglomerate Bakrie & Brothers on a Bisnis Indonesia newspaper report that the firm planned to build a $50 million tourism complex in Lampung, south Sumatra.
* Retailer Multipolar on news that retail tycoon Hari Dharmawan had completed his plan to buy an additional five percent stake in the firm, taking his holding to 10 percent.
* Small chemical firm Duta Pertiwi Nusantara on market talk of a possible rights issue, business diversification and a stock split.
* Small property firm Elang Realty following announcement of poor 1996 financial results and a link-up with retailer PT Gelael.
